name: panther-ivy-plugin
description: Ivy formal protocol tester. LSP + MCP servers, NCT/NACT/NSCT methodology, and 14-layer templates for writing, compiling, verifying, and running protocol specs against real implementations.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Ivy LSP/MCP log verbosity (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)

enable_serena.title: Enable Serena
enable_serena.description: Enable the Serena MCP server for semantic code intelligence (requires panther-serena submodule)

force_reinstall.title: Force Reinstall
force_reinstall.description: Force uvx to reinstall ivy-lsp on every server start (use when modifying local ivy-lsp source)

observability_enabled.title: Enable Observability
observability_enabled.description: Enable observability event logging to JSONL files (true/false)

statusline_mode.title: Statusline Mode
statusline_mode.description: How the plugin statusline composes with the global statusline: ivy-only | minimal | full-delegate | suppress-overlaps (default)
